<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Happy Birthday, Preetu ♡</title>
<style>
:root{--pink:#f58fba;--deep:#9c456f;--cream:#fff8f3;--peach:#ffe8df;--ink:#573846}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:var(--ink);background:radial-gradient(circle at 12% 12%,#fff 0 2px,transparent 3px),linear-gradient(135deg,#fff5ef,#ffe2ec 55%,#fff0e7);overflow-x:hidden}
main{width:min(900px,92%);margin:auto;padding:30px 0 55px;text-align:center}
.pill{display:inline-block;padding:9px 17px;border:1px solid #f4bfd2;border-radius:30px;background:#ffffffa8;font:600 12px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--deep);text-transform:uppercase}
.hero{padding:24px 18px 16px}
.gif{width:170px;height:170px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 12px #d98bab44);animation:bob 3s ease-in-out infinite}
h1{font-size:clamp(42px,8vw,76px);line-height:1.02;margin:12px 0;color:#a84e79;font-weight:normal;letter-spacing:-2px}
h1 span{display:block;font-style:italic;color:#e477a6}
.sub{font:15px/1.8 Arial,sans-serif;color:#865c6d;max-width:560px;margin:14px auto 0}
.card{margin:22px auto 0;padding:30px 22px;max-width:680px;border:1px solid #f5c7d7;border-radius:28px;background:#ffffffb8;box-shadow:0 18px 50px #b9688a1c;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.card h2{font-size:29px;font-weight:normal;margin:0 0 10px;color:#a84e79}
.card p{font:15px/1.9 Arial,sans-serif;color:#795b68;margin:8px auto;max-width:540px}
button{border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:16px 27px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ed8db6,#c85d91);color:white;font:600 14px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.3px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 9px 22px #c85d9144;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
button:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 13px 25px #c85d9155}
button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #a84e79;outline-offset:4px}
#surprise{display:none;margin:26px auto 0;animation:appear .8s ease both}
#surprise.show{display:block}
.flower{width:min(330px,75vw);border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 15px 40px #9d547133;border:6px solid white}
.love-note{font-size:clamp(22px,4vw,31px);line-height:1.5;color:#a84e79;margin:18px auto 8px;font-style:italic}
.personal-wish{font:15px/2 Arial,sans-serif;color:#795b68;margin:16px auto;max-width:560px;text-align:center;padding:0 5px}\n.signature{font:13px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1px;color:#a26b82;margin-top:20px}
.footer{margin-top:30px;font:12px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1px;color:#b17d91}
.sparkle{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;z-index:5;animation:float 2.8s ease-out forwards;font-size:22px}
@keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-2deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px) rotate(2deg)}}
@keyframes appear{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px) scale(.97)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
@keyframes float{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(0) scale(.6) rotate(0)}15%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-170px) scale(1.3) rotate(25deg)}}
@media(max-width:480px){main{padding-top:18px}.card{padding:25px 16px}.gif{width:145px;height:145px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main>
  <div class="pill">a little surprise made with love</div>
  <section class="hero">
    <img class="gif" alt="Cute birthday bear holding balloons" src="data:image/gif;base64,">
    <h1>Happy Birthday,<span>Preetu ♡</span></h1>
    <p class="sub">Today is all about you — your smile, your kindness, and all the little things that make you so special.</p>
  </section>

  <section class="card">
    <h2>To my favourite person</h2>
    <p>May your day be filled with warm hugs, pretty flowers, sweet surprises and a thousand reasons to smile. You deserve all the happiness in the world.</p>
    <p>There's one little surprise waiting for you…</p>
    <button id="openBtn" type="button" onclick="openSurprise()">Open your surprise ✨</button>
    <div id="surprise" aria-live="polite">
      <img class="flower" alt="Cute little bear holding a pink flower" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
      <div class="love-note">I love you so much, Preetu. ♡</div>
      <p class="personal-wish">Happy birthday mera pyara sa golu molu Preetu ji 💕😁, apka din aur ye saal bohot khushiyon se guzre. Apke papers ache jayein, apko Bhagwan se buddhi mile ji, aap bohot ache marks leke pass ho jao. And I wish aap mere paas wapas aa jao. Apka bohot khayal rakhunga, jaise abhi rakh raha hoon usse bhi zyada ji. Aur apki khushi ko kisi ki nazar na lage. Always be happy, my dear chhotu. Love you so much 💕😁🌹</p>
      <div class="signature">MADE WITH ALL MY LOVE · FOR PREETU</div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <div class="footer">♡ YOUR DAY · YOUR SMILE · MY HAPPINESS ♡</div>
</main>
<script>
function openSurprise(){
  const surprise=document.getElementById('surprise');
  surprise.classList.add('show');
  document.getElementById('openBtn').textContent='Surprise opened! Sending you hugs ♡';
  document.getElementById('openBtn').disabled=true;
  for(let i=0;i<28;i++) setTimeout(()=>{
    const el=document.createElement('span');
    el.className='sparkle';
    el.textContent=['♡','💕','✨','🌸'][Math.floor(Math.random()*4)];
    el.style.left=(5+Math.random()*90)+'vw';
    el.style.top=(55+Math.random()*35)+'vh';
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),2900);
  },i*65);
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
